senses.gloss:
एकैक एकैक, i. e. एक-एक,
 I. adj., f. का.
 1. Every one, Draup. 8, 17.
 2. One successively, Kathās. 18, 265.
 II. कम्, adv. One by one, Rām. 1, 13, 27.
 III. comparat. एकैकतर, adj. Always one of many, Bhāg. P. 2, 10, 41.

एकैकशस् एकैक + शस्, adv.
 1. One by one, Nal. 1, 25.
 2. One after another, Rām. 4, 45, 16.
एकैकश्य एकैकश्य, i. e. एकैकशस् + य, n. Singleness, MBh. 3, 14903 (fighting one by one).
